description: List the roles defined in this workspace and the permission strings each one grants. Read-only and takes no input. Returns { count, items }; each item is { id, name, slug, permissions, isDefault, isSystem }. isSystem marks a built-in role such as Owner, whose permissions are ["*"] (everything). isDefault marks the role an invitation gets when it names no role. This lists roles, not people - to see who holds which role, use list_team.
name: list_roles
title: List roles
